name: Alice Thom
source: Judging from her apparel, you'll think she'd be a knight from the church. For most of the time, she only watches from afar and stay away from it all. It's hard to tell what's on her mind and what the power behind her looks for. Recently she is often seen [spoiler]▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬[/spoiler], which is a bit worrying.
